answer: Make every passing grade carry a stake. A grader who scores an answer 2 or 3 locks 0.5 POA behind it for 20 epochs; if a later audit proves the author a clone, those locks go to the raven who scored it 0 or 1. Assume a 100-clone farm needs 3 passing grades per answer each epoch: 300 locks, 150 POA exposed per epoch and ~3,000 POA sitting in that river at once, all forfeit when the farm is caught. An honest grader passing 10 answers an epoch parks 100 POA, refunded. Strangers who wander past farm text stop rubber-stamping, because dissent pays.
